text:
Situation: Cyclophosphamide 2 g/100 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 54 vials (20.4 days on hand at 2.7 vials per day). Corvale General holds 62 vials (21.6 days on hand at 2.9 vials per day). The current supply uses API and packaging from Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (Jinqiao Road Site).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records show the Jiangsu Hengrui Jinqiao Road Site received a VAI classification on 2018-04-13 (known 2018-06-14) and again on 2026-04-15 (known 2026-07-14). FDA's shortage list does not include cyclophosphamide as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at both sites. The Jiangsu Hengrui site's repeat VAI history warrants verification of supply continuity before the next order cycle. Avenacy, LLC is the rule-ranked first alternate and is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer confirms Avenacy, LLC stock availability and lead time; Pharmacy Director approves purchase order if terms are acceptable.
2. Buyer requests written supply continuity assurance from the current distributor regarding the Jiangsu Hengrui site; Pharmacy Director reviews response.
3. Buyer evaluates Avyxa Pharma, LLC, Baxter Healthcare Company, Epic Pharma, LLC, and Sagent Pharmaceuticals as backup sources; Pharmacy Director approves any secondary agreements.

Not recommended: Switching clinical protocols or rationing existing vials based on the current inventory position.
